acceptance_behavior: a new sandbox module runs one shell command for a check inside a runc container with a read-only host runtime subset, an unprivileged uid with no capabilities, and a seccomp filter
the container has no network: a check cannot reach a host listener or an external address
a probe proves the boundary (non-root, host canary invisible, no network) and fails closed
timeouts kill the whole container and clean up; resource limits apply
tests exercise the real runc boundary
intent.objective: Candidate-controlled checks currently run at the control-plane uid with absolute-path reach (event store, credentials, other worktrees, the shared .git) and network access; environment filtering and PID namespaces are not a boundary. Implement an enforced boundary on `runc`: no network, no access to the control-plane DB, credentials, other worktrees or the shared .git, only the candidate tree visible, bounded runtime; fail closed when the boundary cannot be enforced.
